summary: Full end-to-end testing of Roofing Monkeys landing + booking. Backend (12/12) and frontend (20/20 effective) all pass. Branding, phone (+1 (647) 954-1671 with tel:+16479541671), $1,500 OFF offer badge, services (5), testimonials (8), gallery (5), trust (6), FAQ (5 with accordion), lead form validation + submit-to-booking flow, sessionStorage persistence, booking page (4 days skipping Sundays, 3 time slots 10AM/2PM/6PM, Confirm button enable logic, success screen), and mobile sticky CTA bar all verified. GTM (GTM-WH7QQKDC) and Microsoft Clarity (w0bf7lchr8) scripts present in index.html. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend LandingPage.jsx and BookingPage.jsx do not call backend /api/lead or /api/booking — they only push to GTM dataLayer and (when configured) an external webhook URL. Backend endpoints exist but are unused. If user wants leads persisted server-side, frontend should POST to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/lead` and `/api/booking`. Currently no DB write happens for submissions. Acceptable per problem statement (webhooks deferred), but worth flagging.

Backend /api/lead and /api/booking do not persist to MongoDB despite Mongo being configured (`db = client[DB_NAME]` is unused). Lead/booking data is silently discarded on the server — only the response confirmation is returned.
LandingPage.jsx is ~677 lines (>700-line guideline is borderline). Consider splitting Services/Testimonials/FAQ/Trust into sub-components for maintainability.
FORM_WEBHOOK_URL and BOOKING_WEBHOOK_URL are hardcoded empty strings in source — should ideally come from process.env so they can be configured without a code change.

BookingPage selects day via `selectedDay?.dayNumber === day.dayNumber` — could collide across month boundaries (two days with same dayNumber in different months would both appear selected). Use full date comparison or index instead.
